login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Enter the admin password to manage your Minecraft servers.
login.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.
login.failed: Couldn't sign in. Please try again.
login.hint: Forgot it? Run {command} on the panel's server.

placeholder.title: Coming soon
placeholder.message: This section is still being built.

errors.network: Can't reach the panel. Check your connection and try again.
errors.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.logoutFailed: Couldn't log out. Please try again.

servers.passwordUnchanged: Leave empty to keep the current password
servers.passwordHint: Stored on the panel's server only. Never sent to the browser.
servers.passwordHintEdit: Only needed to change it, or if you change the host or RCON port.
servers.gamePortHint: Used to check whether the server is online.

errors.nameTaken: Another server already has this name.
errors.passwordRetype: Enter the RCON password again to change the host or RCON port.
errors.saveFailed: Couldn't save the server. Please try again.

test.ok: Connection OK: RCON answered in {ms} ms.
test.failed: Couldn't run the test. Please try again.

error.ECONNREFUSED: Connection refused. Check the RCON port and that RCON is enabled (enable-rcon=true) in server.properties.
error.ETIMEDOUT: The connection timed out. Check the host, the port and any firewall in between.
error.EHOSTUNREACH: The host can't be reached. Check the address and your network.
error.ENOTFOUND: That host name doesn't exist. Check the spelling.
error.AUTH_FAILED: Wrong RCON password. It must match rcon.password in server.properties.
error.CLOSED: The server closed the connection. Check that RCON is enabled and try again.
error.TIMEOUT: The server didn't answer in time. Try again in a moment.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.message: This removes the server from CraftRCON, along with its saved history and scheduled tasks. Your Minecraft server isn't touched.
delete.failed: Couldn't delete the server. Please try again.

empty.title: Welcome to CraftRCON
empty.message: Add your first Minecraft server to manage it from here. You will need its host, RCON port and RCON password.

loadFailed.title: Couldn't load your servers
loadFailed.message: Check your connection and try again.

console.subtitle: Run commands on {name} over RCON.
console.exportTitle: Download the visible output as a .txt file
console.clearTitle: Clear the screen (Ctrl+L). History and favorites stay.
console.rconNote: RCON only returns the reply to each command sent. Chat and server events don't appear here.

empty.title: Ready when you are
empty.message: Replies to your commands appear here. Try one:

originTitle.ui: Run from another page of the panel

errors.too_long: That command is too long for RCON (max. 1446 bytes).
errors.not_found: This server no longer exists in the panel.
errors.failed: The command couldn't be sent. Please try again.
errors.ECONNREFUSED: Connection refused. Is the server running with RCON enabled?
errors.ETIMEDOUT: The connection timed out. Check the host and any firewall.
errors.ENOTFOUND: The server's host name doesn't exist.
errors.AUTH_FAILED: Wrong RCON password. Update it in Servers.
errors.CLOSED: The server closed the connection. The next command will reconnect.
errors.TIMEOUT: The server didn't answer in time.

confirm.title: Run this command?
confirm.message: It's on your list of commands that need confirmation:
confirm.hint: You can edit this list in Settings.

favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.empty: Save the commands you use most and run them with one click.
favorites.label: Name
favorites.commandHint: Runs exactly as typed. The leading / is optional.

delete.title: Delete “{label}”?

errors.saveFailed: Couldn't save the favorite. Please try again.
errors.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete the favorite. Please try again.

history.title: History
history.hint: Click one to edit it, or press ↑ in the input.

cmd.attribute: Read or change an entity attribute
cmd.ban: Ban a player from the server
cmd.datapack: Enable, disable or list data packs
cmd.debug: Start or stop a debug profile
cmd.defaultgamemode: Set the mode for new players
cmd.execute: Run a command with a changed context
cmd.fill: Fill a region with a block
cmd.fillbiome: Fill a region with a biome
cmd.gamerule: Show or set a game rule
cmd.help: List commands or show their usage
cmd.jfr: Start or stop a JFR profile
cmd.kick: Kick a player from the server
cmd.locate: Find the nearest structure or biome
cmd.loot: Drop or give loot table items
cmd.return: Return a value from a function
cmd.setidletimeout: Kick idle players after N minutes
cmd.time: Show or change the time of day
cmd.title: Show a title on screen
